name: Internet & cloud outages
summary: No major multi-hour cloud, CDN or payments outage found 9 to 11 Nov
state: Outage trackers showed no major Cloudflare incident since 22 Oct, and searches for 9 to 11 Nov found no major multi-hour cloud, CDN or payments outage (StatusGator). The level stays Normal.
for_you: No action needed. Provider status pages give the quickest confirmation if a service stops working.

drivers: Software updates, configuration errors, attacks, power failures.
